questions.q: How is a log fundamentally different from a metric in CloudWatch?
options: A metric is a numerical value over time; a log is a detailed, often unstructured record of an event
Logs cannot be retained for more than 24 hours
Logs and metrics are two names for exactly the same kind of data
Metrics can only come from S3, while logs can only come from EC2
questions.explain: Metrics are numbers like CPUUtilization measured over time, while logs are detailed records of events, like an error message or an access log line.

questions.q: What is a log group in CloudWatch Logs?
options: An alarm that watches multiple metrics at once
A single line of text written by an application
A synonym for an SNS topic
The top-level container for related log streams, with its own retention setting
questions.explain: A log group is typically one per application or resource type, and it has its own retention setting, defaulting to Never Expire.

questions.q: Why doesn't a file like /var/log/messages on an EC2 instance show up in CloudWatch Logs automatically?
options: AWS deletes all operating-system log files every hour
EC2 instances are not capable of writing log files
Platform-level monitoring can't see inside the guest OS, so something running inside the OS has to ship the log out
CloudWatch Logs only accepts logs from Lambda functions
questions.explain: Just like platform metrics, which come from the hypervisor, CloudWatch has no automatic visibility inside an instance's own OS — an agent has to be installed to ship logs out.

questions.q: What does the CloudWatch Agent do?
options: Installed inside an instance's OS, it ships configured log files (and OS-level metrics) to CloudWatch
It is a billing tool that calculates the monthly AWS bill
It automatically deletes old EC2 instances
It replaces IAM roles for EC2 instances
questions.explain: The CloudWatch Agent is driven by a config file naming which local log files to watch and which log group to send them to — and it can also push OS-level metrics like memory usage.

questions.q: What is CloudWatch Logs Insights used for?
options: Querying and searching log data already stored in CloudWatch Logs, such as filtering for error messages across many log streams at once
Publishing custom metrics with PutMetricData
Setting up SNS topics for alarm notifications
Creating new EC2 instances from a saved AMI
questions.explain: Logs Insights is a query language, similar in spirit to KQL, that searches log data across a log group's streams instead of checking each one by hand.
